headlines.title: STX Q3 deep dive: data center strength and technology transition drive outperformance
headlines.summary: Data storage manufacturer Seagate (NASDAQ:STX) reported calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027) results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 61% year on year to $4.23 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($4.8 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 6.7% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $7.68 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: Sandisk Sinks 9% Despite Earnings Beat, Raised Guidance and 8-for-1 Split; Western Digital Tumbles 8%, Seagate Slides 7%, Micron Falls 6%
headlines.summary: Sandisk just posted a blowout quarter, announced a massive buyback, and unveiled an 8-for-1 stock split, yet shares cratered anyway and dragged the entire memory sector down with them. What spooked investors enough to sell one of this year's hottest stocks on its best news yet?

headlines.title: Should Investors Buy Seagate's Shares After Q1 Earnings Momentum?
headlines.summary: STX's record results, rising AI-driven storage demand, expanding margins and debt reduction strengthen its growth outlook, but does its valuation leave room for further upside?

headlines.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Western Digital and Seagate Technology
headlines.summary: Seagate and Western Digital capitalize on surging AI-driven storage demand, but stronger returns on equity and lower valuation give Seagate an edge.

description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc engages in providing data storage solutions in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers External and internal hard drives; external and internal solid-state drives (SSDs); enterprise hard drives and SSDs; data storage systems; network attached storage (NAS) hard drives; video and analytics hard drives; and hyperscale and cloud solution. It offers its products for Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Surveillance & Security, and telecommunication industry. The company sells its products primarily to original equipment manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Singapore.
